pages.text: $(thing)Mekanism$() 10.4 adds the Chemical Pipe.$(br)$(thing)JEI$() and $(thing)EMI$(): how-to pages on Flowline's items, and drag an item or fluid onto a filter slot or into the rule editor.$(br)$(thing)Jade$(), $(thing)The One Probe$() and $(thing)WTHIT$() show the looked-at side's mode, pacing, priority and regulator.$(br2)Wrenches tagged $(thing)forge:tools/wrench$() work on pipes.
